notes: Queue is modelled with absolute counters (wcnt/wbase in the write domain, rcnt in the read domain) plus a small memory array. This avoids a queue driven from two clocks. At a coincident edge the read check sees pre-edge state, so the read happens before the write push. Clear is wbase<=wcnt on the first write edge that samples busy 1→0, or while either hardware reset is asserted. That edge's own write is still pushed. The OCC_W/OCC_R comparisons are not implemented. CHK-010 and CHK-004 signals are not in the interface, so only the bounds, full-when-DEPTH and empty-when-0 parts are checked. The CHK-007 read-side assertion shares fails_CHK_007 with the write-side one, because only one fails counter exists. Its hits are not counted, because incrementing hits_CHK_007 from the read clock would add a second driver.
